image_description: A medium shot of a smiling young man wearing a black academic gown with white facings and a mortarboard cap. He is standing outdoors in front of a brick building, flanked by two other men, one in a suit and one in casual wear. The gown features wide sleeves with white trim and a V-shaped opening revealing a shirt and tie.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is cropped at the waist/thigh level; the 'ankles' and full length are not visible, so the full silhouette cannot be verified.
The gown exhibits clear bilateral symmetry with a distinct vertical opening down the center front.
The fabric hangs loosely and does not cling to the torso, effectively obscuring the underlying body shape.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The sleeves are visibly wide and feature the characteristic bell shape that extends past the wrists/hands.
Distinct vertical panels (facings) are visible along the front opening of the gown.
A collared shirt and patterned tie are clearly visible underneath the gown.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fabric appears opaque and non-reflective, consistent with heavy academic robe material.
There are no specular highlights or glossy reflections on the black fabric.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Characteristic sleeve drape extending past the wrist.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The sleeve cuffs hang lower than the subject's hands, matching the specific diagnostic criteria.

The mortar lines in the brickwork show slight waviness and inconsistency in perspective convergence, though less severe than the foreground artifacts.

To audit the structural integrity of the arms and hands emerging from the wide sleeves, checking for extra limbs or fusion.
